items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the log of the associated number in the specified base extracted by given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算由给定AggregationExpression提取的关联数字在指定底数下的对数。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the log of a the associated number in the specified base.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算指定基数下关联数字的对数。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the log of the associated number in the specified base referenced via fieldReference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算指定基数下与字段引用相关联数字的对数。

items.source: Use the evaluated value of the given AggregationExpression as log base.
items.translation: 使用给定AggregationExpression的评估值作为对数底。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Use the given value as log base.
items.translation: 使用给定值作为对数底数。

items.source: Use the value stored at the given field as log base.
items.translation: 使用给定字段中存储的值作为对数底数。

items.source: Uses of ArithmeticOperators.Log in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ArithmeticOperators.Log 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
